title: Apparel Quality and Product Development Director
text:
**Lead Global Quality Assurance, Product Integrity & Regulatory Compliance**
You’ll own end-to-end quality leadership across apparel and other product categories, ensuring products meet required safety, regulatory, and performance standards before they reach customers. This role focuses on building practical quality programs, protecting product integrity, and maintaining compliance across the full supply chain.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage global QA strategies, processes, and quality standards aligned to applicable regulations and internal requirements.
* Oversee supplier and factory audits, driving corrective actions and continuous improvement to reduce risk and defects.
* Lead product safety and compliance reviews, ensuring documentation and testing requirements are met for each product line.
* Analyze quality performance data to identify root causes, track trends, and recommend targeted improvements.
* Partner with product development, sourcing, and logistics teams to embed quality into design decisions, production plans, and release readiness.
* Provide leadership for QA teams, including guidance, prioritization, and consistent execution of quality initiatives.

**What Success Looks Like**
High compliance outcomes, stronger supplier performance, fewer quality escapes, and clear, data-driven improvements that support reliable product launches across markets.
